# Avalanche Bridge

> Avalanche Bridge moves supported Ethereum assets to Avalanche C-Chain and back, using locked collateral, minted representations, and your own wallet signatures.

## Key facts
- Route: Ethereum mainnet  Avalanche C-Chain
- Deposit: Ethereum leg typically waits for 96 confirmations
- Withdraw: Return unwraps and releases the Ethereum asset; do not resubmit
- Gas: ETH on Ethereum, AVAX on C-Chain
- Custody: Your wallet signs; collateral sits under bridge architecture
- Verify: Use the official interface; beware fake bridge sites
